payload.reason: Subsumed by ST0032's AC-03.3, which utilz-vc is descoping to ST0033 in the same exchange and which came first, is written per-defect, and is what issue 0135 actually requires: a creation reporting no space is retried up to CREATE_SPACE_TRIES while one reporting a space is attempted once. Keeping both would assert the same requirement twice on one thread. The call-count assertions beyond AC-03.3's scope, that nothing is created when the count cannot be read first and that a bound display adds no further calls, moved into AC-01.1 rather than being lost.
